checks.root_repairs: Corrected the O(r) branch-height attribution from Item315 to Item314, added direct audited pins for Items250, 314, and 349, canonicalized status and replay paths, and regenerated byte-identical certificate and root replays.

mathematical_audit.double_sheet: For transverse q, q and k_*=2r+3 occupy opposite nonzero classes modulo 3, so 2q-k_* is divisible by 3. It is odd, positive, and below 3q; hence Q_perp=(2q-k_*)/3 is the unique odd lift in (0,q) and 3Q_perp+k_*=2q.
mathematical_audit.terminal: In J_(k_*+2), Q_perp and k_* are odd, so every denominator is even. The string ends at 2q; parity excludes q and the only q-multiple is the top 2q term, whose binomial coefficient is one. The normalized A-tail terminal therefore retains the same affine residue.
mathematical_audit.parity_boundary: The ordinary upper-B parameter D=(r+Q+1)/2 is half-integral for odd r and odd Q_perp. Item250's factorial period and Item409's target residual cannot be obtained by direct substitution. This blocks only the existing even-Q transport, not a separately derived parity-flipped tail.
mathematical_audit.actual_height_chain: Canonical Item314 proves h(a_r)=O(r), Item349 defines Pi_r as a gcd containing num(a_r), and Items413/416 give F^[p] dividing rad(J) with J dividing Pi_r. Nonvanishing makes log|num(a_r)|=O(r), so each actual row contributes O(r).
mathematical_audit.aggregate_screen: One fixed ray has O(M/log M) prime rows and r=O(M), yielding B^[p]=O(M^2/log M). Since every remaining foreign prime q exceeds p comparable to M, total rowwise support count is O(M^2/(log M)^2).
mathematical_audit.capacity: Both bounds remain superlinear. They give neither B_perp=o(M), a positive adaptive-tail-minus-foreign margin, nor combined chart control; the ordinary-j2 ceiling remains 1/105.
